title: Probe Lab — Standup snapshot and boarding queue notes (Nov 18 2026)
body:
Purpose
Weekly snapshot from the Probe Lab standup focused on the boarding queue (models waiting for quantization/eval), small-scale eval results, and blockers for next-step automation. Intended for engineering and research partners who will pick up experiments next sprint.

Attendees
- Aisha (owner)
- Diego (experiment lead)
- Samira (evals)
- Evan (infra/kv-cache)
- Notes from: Lily (synthesis) via chat

High-level summary (TL;DR)
- Two new models completed initial quantization passes (M-7B and X-13B-lite). Both used mixed 4/8-bit GPTQ-style post-training quantization with bias correction.
- M-7B (GPTQ-4) shows 12% throughput uplift and matches baseline on FLAN-Style instruction accuracy within +/-1.8% on our core eval set.
- X-13B-lite compressed to 4-bit-awqV2 yields larger hallucination variance on openQA benchmarks; tagging as "needs calibration" and moved to manual eval queue.
- KV-cache stress test surfaced a latency cliff at sequence lengths >2048 for the quantized M-7B image; mitigations proposed (fast-path for large KV slices + reduced batch coalescing).

Agenda items discussed
1) Boarding queue triage (models + owners)
2) Results from week-long automated eval run (nightly sweep)
3) KV-cache degradation incident reproduction and hotfix plan
4) Onboarding checklist improvements (metadata, rollout gates)
5) Next steps & owners

Boarding queue snapshot (current ordering)
- PR-406: model-M-7B-gptq4 — owner: Diego — status: ready-for-eval -> automated evals passed CI smoke, manual instruction eval queued.
- PR-412: model-X-13B-lite-awq4 — owner: Samira — status: needs-calibration -> openQA hallucinations + tokenization mismatch noted.
- PR-389: model-slim-3B-quant-8bit — owner: Evan — status: canary-ready -> low-memory mode validated, perf baseline established.
- PR-423: model-chat-s9-probe — owner: Aisha — status: preprocessing-fix -> waiting on tokenizer patch (GH #270).

Experiment highlights & numbers (automated run Nov 12–17)
- Eval harness: nightly/automated-run v2.3, seed fixed 42, datasets: Redwood-core-instr-v1, openQA-small, safety-checklist-lite.
- M-7B GPTQ-4: throughput +12% tokens/s (37k -> 41.5k), median per-token latency 8% lower; instr-acc (core) 72.4% vs baseline 74.0% (delta -1.6%). Hallucination rate ~2.1% (within acceptable band).
- X-13B-lite AWQ4: throughput +28% tokens/s but instr-acc down 6.7% (66.3% vs baseline 73.0%). openQA F1 dropped 9 points. Observed systematic answer truncation on long contexts.
- Slim-3B 8-bit: stable; memory footprint 1.3x reduction; small perplexity regression (+0.7 PPL) but acceptable for edge use-cases.

Qualitative notes (manual checks)
- M-7B: instruction-following examples look fine, minor verbosity in multi-step math problems. Worth canary rollout to non-critical routes with aggressive rollback window.
- X-13B-lite: hallucinations clustered around dates/facts; probable tokenization alignment issue with proprietary tokenizer mapping. Samira to run targeted token-alignment diagnostic.

KV-cache regression incident (repro)
- Symptom: 95th percentile latency spikes when sequence length >2048 and concurrent client-batching >8.
- Root cause hypothesis: quantized key/value blocks cause misaligned memory strides leading to cache-line thrash on A100-style nodes when using the current KV compact layout.
- Repro steps recorded in GH gist: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra-experiments/issues/45#issuecomment-91284
- Temporary mitigations: reduce max coalescing to 6 for boarding canaries; pin M-7B canary to nodes with kv-cache fast-path enabled.
- Long term: Evan to prototype alternate KV layout that uses 64-byte aligned slices; bench target: reduce 95p latency by 30% for >2048 tokens.

Onboarding checklist gaps discovered
- Missing: explicit tokenizer mapping file in model metadata (caused X-13B mismatch). Add new required field: tokenizer_hash + sample-token-map.
- Missing: canary gating for openQA drop >5pts (auto-fail). Add to rollout config.
- Missing: cache-warmup step for quantized models (warm prefixes with synthetic prompts). Add as post-deploy job.

Decisions made
- Canary policy for M-7B: start with 1% traffic on hosted-test route for 48h, monitor instr-acc and 95p latency; auto-roll back if instr-acc drops >3pt or 95p latency increases >20%.
- X-13B-lite: do not canary until tokenization mismatch resolved. Move to manual review bucket.
- KV-cache hotfix: short-term config change deployed to staging; next week will run stress sweep across different GPU SKUs.

Action items (owners + rough ETA)
- Diego: write up M-7B canary runbook + add instrumentation hooks (loss traces, token-aligned diffs). ETA: 2026-11-21.
- Samira: run token-alignment diagnostic on X-13B-lite and submit patch to tokenizer mapping (GH #270). ETA: 2026-11-19.
- Evan: prototype KV layout change & microbench (local) and open PR for infra bench harness. ETA: 2026-11-25.
- Aisha: update onboarding checklist (Confluence) and add required metadata fields; drive enforcement in onboarding CI. ETA: 2026-11-20.
- Ops: temporarily lower batch coalescing on boarding nodes (deployed 11/18) — monitor and report on 11/19 standup.

Risks / open questions
- How aggressive should we be with 4-bit AWQ variants for larger models given the observed hallucination spikes? (open)
- Is tokenizer mapping best fixed in model bundle or as a cluster-wide shim? (ops vs model ownership question)
- Will the KV layout change interact poorly with other memory optimizations (e.g., fused kernels)? Evan to verify.

Notes to self / rough TODOs
- Capture a short clip of the M-7B canary run for demo next week.
- Add more targeted safety prompts to nightly eval for X-13B-lite to catch hallucination patterns early.
- Re-run smaller-batch AWQ variants with bias correction toggled off/on to isolate failure mode.

Next meeting
- Probe Lab standup: 2026-11-19 09:30 PT (quick checkpoint on canary + token mapping).
- Deep dive on KV-cache: 2026-11-20 11:00 PT (Evan leading).

Appendix (short links / quick refs)
- Nightly eval run: https://internal.redwood.ai/runs/nightly/2026-11-12-17
- GH: PR-406 (M-7B GPTQ-4): https://github.com/redwood-inference/quant-experiments/pull/406
- GH: tokenizer patch draft: https://github.com/redwood-inference/tokenizers/pull/270

-- end of snapshot
